A due slot is skipped free when the previous run is still going or paused, or the balance or key limit is below the per-run cap; three skips in a row pause the schedule, and a run that could pass `max_credits_per_month` pauses it until the next UTC month. Events (`discover.new_rows`, `discover.run_skipped`, `discover.run_failed`, ...) go to the [event feed](#account-event-feed-v1events).

## Account Event Feed (`/v1/events`)

Discover runs and schedules (and webhook endpoints) write events to a per-account log. Read it here by polling, or have it pushed with [webhook endpoints](#webhook-endpoints-v1webhook-endpoints); an event reads the same on both. Not a registry endpoint; every call is free. Retention is **30 days**.

- **`GET /v1/events`** returns `data.items[]` oldest first and `pagination { next_cursor, has_more }`. Start from `cursor=oldest` (the default), `cursor=now`, an event id (`evt_…`) or a saved `next_cursor`. Or pass `consumer=<name>` (1-64 chars `[a-z0-9_-]`, created on first read, optional `start=now|oldest`) and the server keeps your position: a consumer read returns the same page until you ack it. `limit` 1-500 (default 100); `types` (exact types, `ns.*` or `*`); `subject_id` (run or schedule ids). `wait_s` 0-25 holds an empty read until an event arrives (at most 5 waiting reads per key; past that it answers at once with `X-Poll-Interval: 5`). Time params (`since`, `from`) are refused: the feed is cursor-only.
- **`POST /v1/events/consumers/{name}/ack`** with body `{ "cursor": "<pagination.next_cursor of the page you processed>" }` commits the consumer's position.
- **Event envelope:** `{ id, type, api_version, created_at, cursor, subject: { kind, id, name? } | null, data, links }`. Ids are deterministic: de-duplicate on `id`. Types: `discover.progress`, `discover.accounts_ready`, `discover.completed`, `discover.partial`, `discover.paused`, `discover.failed`, `discover.new_rows`, `discover.new_accounts`, `discover.new_items`, `discover.run_skipped`, `discover.run_failed`, `endpoint.disabled`.
- **`410 CURSOR_EXPIRED`** when your position is older than retention, with `details.oldest_cursor`, `missed_from` and `missed_until`: restart from `oldest_cursor` (a consumer restarts by itself) and tell the user events in that window were missed. A `503` (`store_unavailable` / `store_timeout`) is free: retry after `Retry-After`.

## Webhook Endpoints (`/v1/webhook-endpoints`)

Account-level push for the event feed (today: discover runs and schedules). Distinct from a monitor's own `webhook_url` ([monitors.md](monitors.md)) and the `prism/jobs` completion webhook, which sign with `x-socialcrawl-signature`; these sign with **Standard Webhooks** headers. Every route is free and answers only to **the API key that created the endpoint** (another key gets a 404, and revoking the key disables its endpoints).

| Route | Notes |
|---|---|
| `POST /v1/webhook-endpoints` | Body `{ url, types?, description?, subject_ids? }`. `url` is public https on port 443; `types` 1-50 exact types, `ns.*` or `*` (default `["*"]`), for example `["discover.*"]`. Answers 201 with `data { endpoint, secret }`: the `whsec_…` secret is shown **once**. 20 endpoints per key. Honours `Idempotency-Key` (a replay returns `secret: null`). |
| `GET /v1/webhook-endpoints`, `GET /{id}` | List (newest first, `limit` 1-100, `cursor`, `status`) or read one. |
| `PATCH /v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}` | Any of `url`, `types`, `description`, `subject_ids`, `status` (`enabled` \| `disabled`). Re-enabling resumes parked deliveries. |
| `DELETE /v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}` | Deletes it with its deliveries. |
| `POST /v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}/rotate-secret` | New secret, shown once; for 24 h every delivery is signed with the old and the new one. Honours `Idempotency-Key`. |
| `POST /v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}/test` | Sends one signed sample now and returns the attempt's `outcome`. |
| `GET /v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}/attempts` | Delivery attempts, newest first. |

**Delivery:** a POST with body `{ "id", "type": "event.batch", "data": { "events": [<event envelope>, …] } }` (at most 100 events or 256 KB), at least once: de-duplicate on each event's `id`. Any 2xx delivers. A 410 disables the endpoint at once; other failures retry on a ladder (immediately, 30 s, 2 m, 10 m, 1 h, 4 h, 12 h, 24 h), honouring a `Retry-After` on 429/5xx, and an endpoint failing for 5 days is disabled. Each disable writes an `endpoint.disabled` event.

**Verify every delivery.** Headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` (space-separated `v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>`, two during a rotation). Sign `"{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{raw body}"` with the **base64-decoded** part of the secret after `whsec_`, accept any matching `v1` entry, compare in constant time, and reject a timestamp more than 300 s off:

```js
import crypto from "node:crypto";
function verify(rawBody, h, secret, tol = 300) {
  const id = h["webhook-id"], ts = h["webhook-timestamp"], sigs = h["webhook-signature"];
  if (!id || !/^\d+$/.test(ts ?? "") || Math.abs(Date.now() / 1000 - Number(ts)) > tol) return false;
  const key = Buffer.from(secret.replace(/^whsec_/, ""), "base64");
  const exp = crypto.createHmac("sha256", key).update(`${id}.${ts}.`).update(rawBody).digest();
  return (sigs ?? "").split(" ").some((e) => {
    const [v, s] = e.split(",");
    const got = Buffer.from(s ?? "", "base64");
    return v === "v1" && got.length === exp.length && crypto.timingSafeEqual(got, exp);
  });
}
```

## Platform Status

```bash
curl -s "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/status"          # platforms with a problem right now
curl -s "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/status/youtube"  # one platform: every endpoint, 90 daily cells, open incidents
```

Both are public (no API key) and cost 0 credits. They read the status page engine, which recomputes every minute from real uncached customer calls (our own test traffic excluded) plus our own probes and referee canaries. The SLI is `success / (success + 5xx)`; 4xx never count, and designed 503s (withdrawn endpoint, unserved region) are excluded.

- **`/v1/status`** keeps its long-standing shape: top-level `status` is `operational` or `degraded`; `platforms[slug]` lists only platforms with a problem (`degraded` or `down`) with their failing `endpoints`; additive `incidents` (open public incidents: `id`, `title`, `status`, `impact`, `url`, `components`) and `status_page`. If the status data is more than 5 minutes old it falls back to the circuit breaker and the last 30 minutes of calls.
- **`/v1/status/{platform}`** returns `platform`, `endpoints[]` (state, `since`, `uptime_90d`, 90 UTC `days`) and `incidents`. States: `operational`, `degraded_performance` (shown "Elevated error rate"), `partial_outage`, `major_outage`, `under_maintenance`, `no_data` ("No recent traffic"). Unknown platform: `404`. Status data unavailable: `503` with `Retry-After: 60`, never a guessed state.
- **On any 5xx**, the error body carries `error.status_url` (`https://www.socialcrawl.dev/status?platform=<slug>`) and, when an open public incident explains the failure, `error.incident` (`id`, `title`, `status`, `impact`, `url`). Agent rule: if `error.incident` is present, stop retrying that platform, poll `/v1/status/{platform}` every few minutes and resume when the incident is gone; otherwise honour `Retry-After` (the breaker-open 503 sends `Retry-After: 30`) and back off. Failed calls are refunded.
- **Feeds** (public, CORS, Statuspage v2 format): `https://www.socialcrawl.dev/status/api/v2/summary.json` (also `status.json`, `components.json`, `incidents.json`, `incidents/unresolved.json`, `scheduled-maintenances*.json`), `https://www.socialcrawl.dev/status/history.rss` and `history.atom`, and badges at `/status/badge/{overall|api|<platform>}.svg`.
- **Subscriptions** (email, Slack, signed webhook, RSS) are set up from the Subscribe button on the status page. Webhooks are signed `x-socialcrawl-signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<raw body>")>`. Full guide: https://www.socialcrawl.dev/docs/status.

## Error Codes

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ERRORS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->
| Code | Status | Retry? | What it means / what to do |
|------|--------|--------|----------------------------|
| MISSING_API_KEY | 401 | no | No x-api-key header on the request. Ask the user for their key and save it to `~/.config/socialcrawl/api_key` |
| INVALID_API_KEY | 401 | no | API key is malformed, not found, revoked, or expired. Tell the user to check the key at https://socialcrawl.dev/dashboard |
| INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS | 402 | no | Credit balance is lower than the endpoint cost. Point the user at https://socialcrawl.dev/dashboard/billing |
| INVALID_REQUEST | 400 | no | A required parameter is missing, a value failed validation, or no one-of group member was provided. Follow `error.details.next_step` when present (`error.details.fields` names a one-of group none of which was sent), and re-read the endpoint's params and Constraints in its platform reference before retrying - this is free, so a retry costs nothing |
| ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND | 404 | no | The platform or resource is not supported. Check references/index.md, or call the free `GET /v1/utility/endpoints` to list the live surface |
| RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND | 404 | no | The requested item was not found on the platform; credits are refunded when triggered by an empty upstream result |
| CONCURRENCY_LIMIT | 429 | yes | More than 50 simultaneous requests on the same API key; honor Retry-After, then back off. Wait for the `Retry-After` value, then retry |
| UPSTREAM_ERROR | 502 | yes | The platform returned an error; credits are automatically refunded. Retry once, then report it as a platform-side outage |
| SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE | 503 | yes | Temporarily unavailable for this platform, either after repeated failures or because the upstream provider is rate-limiting us; honor Retry-After, credits are refunded. Retry after ~30s |
| INTERNAL_ERROR | 500 | yes | Unexpected server error; credits are automatically refunded |
| METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED | 405 | no | Wrong HTTP method for this endpoint. Check the method in the platform reference - the `/v1/web/*` job, monitor, and session routes and the batch endpoints are POST/PATCH/DELETE, not GET |
| IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT | 409 | no | The Idempotency-Key conflicts with an incompatible active reservation. Use a fresh Idempotency-Key |
| IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS | 409 | yes | A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running; retry after the Retry-After delay. Unbilled - wait for Retry-After, then retry with the same Idempotency-Key |
| IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE | 409 | no | The original outcome is known, but its response body exceeded the idempotent replay storage limit; use a new key only to make a new billable request. The prior call already completed; use a new key only to make a new billable request |
| IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH | 422 | no | The Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request payload. Use a fresh Idempotency-Key for the changed payload |
| COHORT_MEMBER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED | 400 | no | The cohort member limit would be exceeded by this upload |
| COHORT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED | 400 | no | The account already holds the maximum number of cohorts |
| COHORT_IDENTITY_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED | 400 | no | The identity platform is not supported for cohort queries |
| COHORT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT | 409 | no | The normalized identity is already assigned to another external ID |
| COHORT_QUERY_NOT_CANCELLABLE | 409 | no | The cohort query is terminal and cannot be cancelled |
| COHORT_QUERY_NOT_READY | 409 | no | The cohort query has not completed and its results are not available |
| COHORT_RESULT_TOO_LARGE | 413 | no | One cohort query result exceeds the maximum response-page size |
| PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE | 413 | no | The JSON request body exceeds the 1 MB size limit |
| RATE_LIMITED | 429 | yes | More than 600 requests in a 1-minute window on the same API key; honor Retry-After, then back off. Unbilled - wait for `Retry-After`, then retry |
| KEY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED | 402 | no | This API key has spent its per-key credit limit; the account balance is unaffected. Raise or reset the key's limit in Dashboard → API Keys, or use a key with no limit |
| RUN_NOT_FOUND | 404 | no | No discover run with this id belongs to your account; start a run |
| RUN_STATE_CONFLICT | 409 | no | The discover run is in a state that does not allow this call, such as resuming a completed run |
| RUN_EXPIRED | 410 | no | The discover run's retention passed and its rows were deleted; start a new run |
| NEEDS_ASYNC | 422 | no | The discover request is over what one call can answer and async=false forbids a background run |
| CURSOR_EXPIRED | 410 | no | The events feed cursor is older than the 30-day retention, so events after it were deleted; restart from cursor=oldest |
| SCHEDULE_NOT_FOUND | 404 | no | No discover schedule with this id belongs to your account; list your schedules |
<!-- END:GENERATED:ERRORS -->

Error envelopes include a `doc_url` anchored on the errors page, `https://www.socialcrawl.dev/docs/errors#<code-slug>` (for example `#insufficient-credits`). `UPSTREAM_ERROR` can also arrive with HTTP status **504** when the source timed out; it is refunded and retryable like the 502.

## Error Details (`error.details`)

Branch on `error.details.reason` when present. Every case below is free (nothing charged or fully refunded).

| Status | `reason` / field | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `page_limit` (+ `max_page`, `requested_page`, `narrow_with`) | The page is past the source's last page for this query (e.g. Instagram reels search stops at page 11 with `date_posted`) | Stop paging; narrow with the params in `narrow_with` |
| 400 | `unsupported_geo_filter` (+ `unknown_parameters`) | A country filter this list cannot apply | Drop it or use an endpoint that filters by country |
| 400 | `suggestions` / `did_you_mean` (+ `unknown_parameters`) | A parameter name was one edit from a real one, or a detail endpoint needs `url` not an id | Fix the name and resend |
| 400 | `missing` + `received_unknown` + `did_you_mean` | A required param was sent under another name (`term` or `q` where the endpoint takes `query`); the message says which name it takes | Resend under the name in `did_you_mean` |
| 400 | `unsupported_date_filter` | `since` / `until` (or a copied spelling) on a list whose rows carry no date | Drop the date; see [Date window](#date-window-since-until) |
| 402 | `balance_too_low` (+ `retry_will_succeed: false`, `next_step`, `top_up_url`, `credits_required`) | Not enough credits | Do not retry: the same request fails until the balance changes. Tell the user to top up. `key_name`, `key_prefix` and `account_email_masked`, when present, say which key and account ran out |
| 402 | `key_budget_reached` (+ `key_settings_url`) | This key hit its own credit limit; the account balance is fine | Do not retry. Raise the key's limit or use another key |
| 402 | `pricing: "ceiling"` (+ `credits_typical`, `lower_cost_options`, `credits_required_cheapest`) | The quoted credits are the most this call can cost (metered hold); `credits_typical` is what it is usually charged | Send one of `lower_cost_options` that fits `credits_remaining`, or top up |
| 404 | `account_gone` / `account_private` / `handle_unresolved` (+ `suggestion`) | See [Account State](#account-state-and-not-found-reasons) | Follow `suggestion` once; do not loop |
| 404 | `site_not_supported` (+ `retry_will_succeed: false`, `suggestion`) | `web/scrape` cannot read this site | Do not retry. For a social link, `suggestion` names the SocialCrawl endpoint that reads it |
| 404 | `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` with `did_you_mean` / `did_you_mean_platform` / `retry_with` | A wrong path, or a bare `/v1/<platform>/search` | Call the URL in `retry_with` (not forwarded for you), or check `GET /v1/utility/endpoints?search=` |
| 5xx | `retry_with` (refunded, `retryable: false`, no `Retry-After`) | The same request would fail the same way; the object names the param change that works (for example `{ "proxy": "auto" }` on `web/scrape`) | Resend once with exactly those params |
| 5xx | `error.incident` (+ `error.status_url`) | An open public incident explains the failure | Stop calling that platform; poll `GET /v1/status/{platform}` |
